subject: science
skillName: Changes That Can and Cannot Be Reversed

items.prompt:
Can water freezing into ice and melting back be reversed?
A) Yes
B) No
C) Only once
D) Never

steps: The ice melts back into water, so it is reversed.

items.prompt:
Can cooking an egg be reversed?
A) Yes
B) No
C) Always
D) Only when cold

steps: A cooked egg cannot become raw again.

items.prompt:
To reverse a change means the material
A) goes back to how it was
B) turns into glass
C) disappears
D) gets heavier
items.answer: A) goes back to how it was

steps: Reversed means returning to the earlier form.

items.prompt:
Melting chocolate and then cooling it so it hardens again is a change that
A) cannot be reversed
B) can be reversed
C) destroys the chocolate
D) makes a cake

steps: The chocolate hardens back into solid chocolate.

items.prompt:
Baking a cake from batter is a change that
A) can be reversed
B) cannot be reversed
C) can be undone by cooling
D) makes batter again

steps: A baked cake cannot turn back into batter.

items.prompt:
Which change CAN be reversed?
A) Cooking an egg
B) Melting ice
C) Baking a cake
D) Burning wood

steps: Melted ice can be frozen again.

items.prompt:
The best argument that cooking an egg cannot be reversed is that
A) heating made a cooked egg that cannot become raw again
B) eggs are small
C) eggs are white
D) the pan is hot
items.answer: A) heating made a cooked egg that cannot become raw again

steps: No cooling turns a cooked egg back to raw.

items.prompt:
Melted chocolate can be made solid again, but a baked cake cannot become batter, because
A) chocolate just changed state, while baking made a new substance
B) cakes are bigger
C) chocolate is sweeter
D) there is no difference
items.answer: A) chocolate just changed state, while baking made a new substance

steps: A state change can reverse, but baking makes a new substance.
